conditions: The PROGRAM module uses a named runtime interface record associated with an included interface type.
limitations: The scope is the documented import mechanism. A mere compile-time definition does not establish a bound target, and one interface type can have more than one runtime record.

triggers: A newly available original, corrected catalog entry, archive byte change, or contrary edition and implementation evidence.

statement: In the Mesa 5.0 manual, a definitions module supplies interface declarations for compile-time type checking. A PROGRAM module can name an interface record of that interface type in IMPORTS, and binding supplies the actual references through that record.
